name: Not Alone

categories.label: Creature wins (Assimilation counter reached Victory space first)
categories.labelVi: Quái vật thắng (Assimilation chạm ô Victory trước)
categories.hint: Creature wins immediately when the Assimilation counter reaches the Victory space

categories.label: Hunted win (Rescue counter reached Victory space first)
categories.labelVi: Người sống sót thắng (Rescue chạm ô Victory trước)
categories.hint: All Hunted win immediately when the Rescue counter reaches the Victory space

roles.label: Creature
roles.winCondition: Assimilation counter reaches the Victory space before the Rescue counter

roles.label: Hunted
roles.winCondition: Rescue counter reaches the Victory space before the Assimilation counter

winCondition: One player is the Creature, the others are the Hunted. No points: whichever counter (Assimilation for the Creature, Rescue for the Hunted) reaches the Victory space first wins immediately; the Rescue counter advances every turn, the Assimilation counter advances when Hunted are caught or give up.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when the Assimilation or Rescue counter reaches the Victory space

notes: family: race-to-goal (asymmetric, no points). Start spaces of both counters depend on player count. Exploration expansion not modelled. Expert variant: a Hunted losing last Will counter in Reckoning regains only 2.

sources.title: Not Alone rulebook (Geek Attitude Games, via 1j1ju)
sources.section: Object of the Game; Phase 3 Reckoning; End of Game
